minutes.headline: Building committee shaped the TC Passios design RFQ (parking, envelope, code, outreach) and set a December 4 meeting.
minutes.summary: The TCP Building Design Committee discussed what to require of architects in the request for qualifications for the TC Passios building: parking analysis, building envelope and systems assessment, code compliance, end-user meetings and community outreach. Members debated space needs for town offices, school programs, the Boys and Girls Club and other uses, and upkeep of the building while its future is undecided. The October minutes were put to a vote and the next meeting was set for December 4.

public_comment.topic: A school department official explained that the building is maintained by the school department, funded from rents (first Fitchburg, now extended day), and that the roof is aging and starting to leak.

A resident urged the RFQ to require CAD/CAM capability, raised code compliance and school use during construction, offered local experts, asked for a town meeting plus ballot vote two weeks later, wanted a comprehensive cost for all town buildings, suggested a drop-off window, and questioned combining so many uses.

votes.motion: Accept the minutes of the Wednesday October 23rd meeting.

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said Town Meeting authorized money for the initial design work leading to a plan and cost estimate.
A school official said upkeep is paid from rent funds, now extended day, which is not adequate, and the roof is leaking.

budget_items.topic: Facilities line returned to free cash
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the facilities line turned back a sizable amount to free cash and asked why it was not used for repairs.

decisions.decision: Next meeting kept for December 4 at 5:30, with the draft RFQ circulated beforehand.
A tour of the building to be arranged.
